sources.groups_note: none = no referrer (lead forms, apps that hide it); own = our sites; google-app = Google app/Discover/Gmail; search = Google/Bing incl. ad click-throughs; social; third-party = other websites, mostly display/PMax placements

demand.note: enquiries = entries into each college's GF-list automation (one per form submission, de-duplicated within 10 minutes); reentries = the same contact entering again within an hour, which writes a duplicate sheet row; new = the contact was created within 6 hours of the submission; repeat = an existing contact enquired again. Channel for repeats is the contact's current source field, i.e. usually the latest submission. Lead counts elsewhere on this board count new contacts only.

notes.allocation_time: udate of the college Registrar field = when the registrar was (last) assigned
notes.registered: lead's CRM ID (or phone) appears in a registration sheet in the window; cancelled rows excluded
notes.staged: Sale Stage field set to anything other than 'Allocated'
